effects.prompt: Put a non-attack action card from your graveyard on top of your deck?

_comment: 'If Cadaverous Contraband hits' = TRIGGERED ON_HIT on the attack card itself (pattern proven by aaz/infecting_shot_blue). The triage list suggested SEARCH_GRAVEYARD, but its handler cannot express this clause: it passes no position to put_object (deck destinations land on the BOTTOM) and defaults shuffle=True for deck destinations. MOVE_MATCHING exists exactly for 'put target <card matching X> from <zone> on top of your deck' (its own handler comment says so), reads to_zone/position/target, and _object_zone_cards supports GRAVEYARD; the filter is ordinary DSL conditions evaluated per candidate, so CARD_IS_TYPE Action + NOT CARD_IS_TYPE Attack expresses 'non-attack action card'. Known wart: the MAY prompt is offered even when no matching card is in the graveyard - CARD_IN_ZONE could gate the offer but its filters are positive-only and cannot count 'action AND NOT attack', so accepting with an empty pool simply does nothing.
